title: The Wrong Revenue Report
description: Finance sees cent-level discrepancies and orders booked to the wrong day around month-end and DST.
objective: Reproduce the reported failures and repair the implementation without changing its public interfaces.
expectedBehavior: daily_revenue groups aware timestamps by the requested IANA timezone (default America/Los_Angeles). Convert money using Decimal(str(value)). Round each order's discounted gross half-up to cents before aggregation. paid contributes gross; refunded contributes negative gross; cancelled contributes zero; partially_refunded contributes gross minus refund_amount (already a dollar amount). Return a mapping from date to numeric dollars, including zero-total days encountered in input.
constraints: Use only the language standard library; no network access or external packages.
The provided tests are read-only; additional private tests verify edge cases.
